summary: Full-stack review of Mobile Business Balance & Profit Tracker. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering auth (login success/invalid, /me), account creation (Cash 20k + HDFC 50k + SBI 30k + UPI 15k), dashboard totals (total_paisa == sum of active balances), retail sale (HDFC +12000, profit 4000), wholesale supply (does NOT affect paisa; receivable +30000) and payment (SBI +30000, outstanding->0), transfer HDFC->SBI 20000 (paisa unchanged, two ledger entries), negative-balance rejection (400), ledger running-balance correctness, poonji separation from paisa, stock add+sell marks status=sold, credit card spend/payment (SBI debited on payment, paisa reduced), profit report math. Frontend smoke test via Playwright: login with seeded credentials succeeds; Dashboard renders Total Paisa/Cash/Bank/UPI stat cards with Indian rupee formatting (e.g. ₹2,05,000); Accounts page lists rows, Add-Account modal creates UI account; Transfer modal opens; Retail sale-form modal opens; Wholesale/Poonji/Stock/CreditCards/Profit pages load with expected test IDs; Dashboard account breakdown rows are clickable and navigate to the ledger page.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal does not close on Escape keypress. It only closes on backdrop click or the X button. After a form submit that programmatically opened the modal, tests pressing Escape leave the backdrop up, and the backdrop-blur overlay can intercept sidebar nav clicks until dismissed. Recommend adding a keydown listener for Escape to onClose.

action_items: (Optional/UX) Add Escape-key handler to Modal component in /app/frontend/src/components/shared.jsx so pressing Esc calls onClose — matches conventional modal UX and prevents lingering backdrops.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 812 lines — consider splitting into routers (accounts, wholesale, retail, creditcards, poonji, dashboard) for maintainability once app grows.
record_transaction runs read-modify-write on account balance without a transaction/session; concurrent updates could produce a race. For a single-owner app this is fine, but noting for future.
Account update endpoint drops null-valued fields via 'v is not None' filter — this means you cannot clear notes/bank_name/last4 by sending null. Acceptable but worth noting.
Login endpoint has no brute-force lockout / rate limiting. Playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails; not implemented here. Not requested in this iteration but flag for security hardening.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. Currently benign because token auth is via Authorization header, but should either restrict origins or set allow_credentials=False.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create accounts prefixed 'TEST_' plus TEST_ wholesale customer, TEST_ stock and TEST_ credit card. These persist in the DB across runs (unique-name suffixed by uuid) but do NOT interfere with UI tests since names are namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 pytest cases run cleanly with: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -p xdist -n 0`. The suite loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Tests are idempotent — they use unique uuid-suffixed names, so re-running is safe (DB just accumulates TEST_ records). Frontend live URL: https://account-manager-app-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Owner login is prefilled on the login page. Only known frontend nit: Modal has no Escape-to-close handler.
